exposure: history of induction and augmentation by untrained personnel
cohort: Pregnant women of any age, parity, gestational age, or booking status with an intra-operative diagnosis of complete uterine rupture at Mardan Medical Complex, Mardan, Pakistan, excluding those with small partial rents or dehiscence.
finding: The frequency of ruptured uterus was 10/1000 deliveries, with the most common risk factors being history of induction/augmentation by untrained personnel (55%), previous cesarean section (20%), and obstructed labor (18%).
